rationale: The stock gapped up ~12% on no identifiable news catalyst, which creates uncertainty about the durability of the move. Price is currently trading below VWAP ($12.97) and the 9-EMA ($13.02), sitting at only 32% of today's range after pulling back from the high of $13.19, suggesting the initial gap momentum has faded. The wide bid-ask spread (54.7 bps) and the ambiguous position between support and resistance make the risk/reward unattractive in either direction without a clearer structural setup.
